identificationModule.briefTitle: Darolutamide in Addition to Standard Androgen Deprivation Therapy and Docetaxel in Metastatic Hormone-Sensitive Prostate Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo Controlled Phase III Study of Darolutamide (ODM-201) Versus Placebo in Addition to Standard Androgen Deprivation Therapy and Docetaxel in Patients With Metastatic Hormone Sensitive Prostate Cancer

armGroups.label: BAY1841788 /darolutamide (ODM-201)+standard ADT+Docetaxel
armGroups.description: Co-administration of BAY 1841788 / darolutamide (ODM-201), standard ADT and docetaxel

armGroups.label: Placebo + standard ADT + Docetaxel
armGroups.description: Co-administration of Placebo matching BAY 1841788 / darolutamide (ODM-201) tablets, standard ADT and docetaxel

interventions.name: BAY1841788 / darolutamide (ODM-201)
interventions.description: 600mg (2 tablets of 300 mg) of darolutamide (ODM-201)/placebo twice daily with food, equivalent to a total a daily dose of 1200 mg in addition to standard ADT (luteinizing hormone releasing hormone (LHRH) agonist/antagonist or orchiectomy) and 6 cycles of docetaxel

interventions.name: Standard ADT (androgen deprivation therapy)
interventions.description: As prescribed by the treating physician.

interventions.name: Docetaxel
interventions.description: As prescribed by the treating physician.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Placebo matching darolutamide (ODM-201) tablets in appearance, bid orally with food, in addition to standard ADT (luteinizing hormone releasing hormone \[LHRH\] agonist/antagonist or orchiectomy) and 6 cycles of docetaxel.
